create_InternalBoundaryConditions: create an InternalBoundaryConditions dataclass with ion temperature, electron temperature, and electron density arrays on the cell grid
build_InternalBoundaryConditions_empty: build an empty InternalBoundaryConditions object from a geometry with zero-valued cell grid arrays
merge_InternalBoundaryConditions: merge two InternalBoundaryConditions objects with non-zero values from the other taking precedence
build_InternalBoundaryConditionsConfig_r: build runtime InternalBoundaryConditions from a config at a given time using sparse time-varying arrays
apply_adaptive_source: apply adaptive source terms to modify source profiles and diagonal matrices for internal boundary conditions
